title: Introduced to Jake Barber before he went public

tellings.quote: I met him I think it was like June of 24 or something along those lines.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says a secret UFO programme took him as a child, met Jake Barber, who later went public with claims about a secret UFO programme, around June 2024, before Barber's story came out. Jose tells Michels he was there himself, and names the journalist Ross Coulthart in connection with it. It places Jose in the same circle before any of it was public.
